title: Story premise ENT114: The Library Book That Came With a Map
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (positive public good). Hook: The books know their symbols. The shelves need to match. Takeaway/theme: Consistent labels can make a shared task easier to join.
description: A volunteer wants to return scattered toy library books to the correct shelves, but abstract section labels confuse every helper. They draw a simple shelf map using the same symbols as the spines, place it on the cart, and finish the return route with a new helper confidently leading.
